title: Scalar-forgetting comparison (nonnegative)
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, k:W→S a morphism, G a Λ-module etale sheaf on W, q a natural number and U→S any etale object. For every A in Over W the fixed raw group Hom((A.hom≫k)^*Λ[U][0],A.hom^*G[q]) is additively isomorphic to H^q(U×_S A,pr_A^*A.hom^*G_ab[0]). These isomorphisms intertwine, for every morphism f:A→B over W, the five-factor higherDirectImageRawOverPullbackHom with restrictedOverCohomologyMap on G_ab. No limit, affineness or qcqs assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tags 03FD and 03Q8; Tag 09Z1 canonical comparison maps

proof.text: Use the natural scalar-forgetting comparison from module raw derived Hom to abelian raw derived Hom with coefficient A.hom^*G_ab.

Compose these isomorphisms with the existing natural abelian raw-Hom/restricted-cohomology isomorphisms. For f use the pointwise scalar-forgetting square and the abelian naturality equation with the coefficient map upperStarComp.inv. The definitions of restrictedOverCohomology and restrictedOverCohomologyMap agree definitionally with the abelian restricted constructions. Extensionality gives the bundled naturality equation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_rawModule_restrictedAbelian_nonnegative
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale) :
    ∃ e : ∀ A : Over W,
      (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op A) ≅
        restrictedOverCohomology k
          ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G)
          (q : ℤ) A U,
      ∀ (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B),
        (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).map f.op ≫ (e A).hom =
          (e B).hom ≫ restrictedOverCohomologyMap k
            ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G)
            (q : ℤ) f U
